$comment: The #158 test case, as the rows a quotation provider would hand the kit (#164).
Texts, works and years are the ones #158 traced on 2026-09-22; the author QIDs are
the Wikidata sitelinks of the Wikiquote pages they came from (Voltaire Q9068,
Ambrose Bierce Q191050). Build 4a replaces this with captured Parsoid pages; until
then it is the smallest honest stand-in: every row names its author by QID and
nothing in it is a name the kit may match on.
`register` rows are the Misattributed section of the Voltaire page: the line is
credited to the person the register says actually wrote it (a candidate), and
Voltaire is the misattribution target, never an authored_by.

quotations.text: It is dangerous to be right in matters on which the established authorities are wrong.
